en: A standard latex balloon loses roughly ten percent of its helium volume every twenty-four hours through microscopic pores.
Osmium is the densest naturally occurring element, making it exactly twice as dense as solid lead.
At twenty degrees Celsius, one hundred milliliters of water can dissolve up to two hundred grams of sugar.
When iron oxidizes into rust, the resulting compound expands to roughly six times its original volume.
Liquid water expands by approximately nine percent in volume when it freezes into solid ice.
Diamond is the hardest natural material, scoring a perfect ten on the Mohs hardness scale.
Earth's atmosphere is a mixture containing roughly seventy-eight percent nitrogen and twenty-one percent oxygen gas.
Sound waves travel about seventeen times faster through solid steel than through the air we breathe.
Mixing baking soda and vinegar causes an endothermic reaction that drops the liquid temperature by about five degrees Celsius.
At the peak of Mount Apo, water boils at roughly ninety degrees Celsius instead of one hundred.
Honey is about two thousand times more viscous than water at room temperature, making it flow slower.
Silver conducts heat about ten percent faster than copper, making it the most conductive natural element.
